_readme: The words for the random events, plus a few of Sam's everyday actions. When each event can happen and what its choices do stay in js/events/random.js.
Any text can be a single string or a list (one is picked at random). Placeholders are filled in by the game: {name} = the lady involved, plus the extras listed in each event's _vars.
Keep the choice keys as they are (they're how the code finds them); change the label and result wording freely.
image (optional): {comp, setting, sam} a picture for that event instead of a generic scene.

haunt.title: {house}: Things That Go Bump
text: Every candle in the east wing lights itself at midnight. Three guests faint. Four ask if they can book that room again.
A portrait in the hallway has started winking at guests. Business is up.
Something rearranged all the furniture in the lounge overnight. Into a much better layout, honestly.

exorcist.label: Call an exorcist (60g)
exorcist.resGhost: The exorcist leaves in tears. {ghost} is offended you asked.

image.comp: translucent ghostly woman drifting through a wall with a mischievous grin, guests fleeing in the background
image.setting: lantern-lit lounge at night, cold blue glow

dayoff.title: A Small Request
dayoff.text: {name} catches Sam in the hallway. "Could I take a few days off? I'm running on fumes."

no.label: Not this week
no.resSoft: {name} says she understands. She looks very tired.
no.res: {name} nods stiffly and goes back to work.

image.comp: slumped at a kitchen table with her head on her arms, tired eyes, untouched cup of tea
image.setting: quiet staff kitchen in the early morning

noble.title: A Noble Invitation
noble.text: A messenger in house livery requests {name}'s company for a private dinner at a nobleman's estate. The offered fee: {gold}.

ask.label: Ask her if she wants to go
ask.res: {name} agrees and returns the next morning with the fee and a smug smile. +{gold}, +renown.
ask.pass: {name} politely passes. Sam sends regrets. She appreciates being asked.

image.comp: on the arm of a richly dressed nobleman at a glittering party, poised elegant smile

guild.title: Guild Celebration
guild.text: Hanna sends word: a party just cleared a dungeon floor and wants company for their victory feast. They asked for {name} by name. Fee: {gold}.

send.label: Send {name}
send.res: It goes great. {name} comes back with the fee and three new admirers. +{gold}.

pass.label: Pass this time
pass.res: Hanna sends back a sad-face doodle.

image.comp: standing at a busy guild counter accepting a sealed contract, adventurers around her
image.setting: bustling adventurers' guild hall, notice boards

taunt.title: The Velvet Thorn
taunt.text: A tall demon woman in red velvet sweeps into the lobby and looks around like she's pricing the furniture. "Lady Isolde Thorne, of the Velvet Thorn. I came to see what the newcomer bought." Her gaze settles on Sam's hoodie. "...Charming."

banter.label: Banter back
banter.win: Sam lands a surprisingly good comeback. Isolde laughs despite herself. Word gets around. +renown.
banter.lose: Sam's comeback arrives about ten seconds late. Isolde is already gone.

polite.label: Stay polite
polite.res: "We'll see how long you last," she says, and leaves.

poach.title: An Offer from the Thorn
poach.text: {name} admits Isolde Thorne offered her a position at the Velvet Thorn, with better pay. She hasn't decided.

raise.label: Offer a raise (+30%)
raise.res: {name} stays. "Okay. You actually value me. Noted."

talk.label: Talk it through
talk.stay: They talk for an hour. {name} decides she'd rather stay.

image.comp: holding a fancy embossed letter, conflicted expression, glancing at a rival's calling card

lucky.title: Lucky Break
text: A regular leaves a coin purse "as a tip." It holds {gold}.
Sam finds {gold} hidden behind a loose brick in the cellar. The old owner had secrets.
A merchant pays {gold} for the ugliest painting in the house. Nobody asks why.

inspector.title: The Inspector
inspector.text: A city inspector with a clipboard announces Sam owes "licensing fees." He says {gold}, but he sounds like he's improvising.

argue.label: Argue the paperwork
argue.win: Sam cites three ordinances that don't exist with total confidence. The inspector leaves, confused. No fee.
argue.lose: It does not go well. {fine} and a lecture.

friends.title: Friends
friends.text: {name} and {other} have started taking their breaks together. Things feel a bit warmer.

image.comp: laughing with another woman over cards at a table, relaxed and happy
image.setting: staff common room in the evening, warm lamplight

quiet.title: A Quiet Moment
quiet.text: {name} finds Sam on the back steps after closing and sits next to him. "You know, you're not what I expected. In a good way."

stay.label: Stay and talk
stay.res: They watch the two moons rise.

image.comp: sitting on the back steps next to him sharing a pot of tea, talking quietly, shoulders touching
image.setting: back steps of an inn at dusk, lanterns coming on, town rooftops

raise.title: Raise Request
raise.text: {name} plants herself in front of Sam's desk. "I'm worth more than {wage} a week, and we both know it. {newWage}."

refuse.label: Refuse
refuse.resProud: {name} stares at Sam for a long, cold moment. She won't forget this.

image.comp: standing in front of a desk with arms folded, determined expression, a list of her accomplishments in hand

incident.title: Trouble at {house}
incident.text: A drunk adventurer starts shoving furniture and shouting about a refund for a service he never actually paid for.

guard.label: Let {guard} handle it
guard.res: {guard} throws him out in about four seconds. The regulars applaud.

sam.label: Sam steps in
sam.win: Sam talks him down. Mostly by being so polite it's confusing. +reputation.
sam.lose: Sam takes a punch, then the drunk falls asleep on his own. Sam gets a black eye and a lot of sympathy.

pay.label: Pay for the damage
pay.res: Broken chairs and a cracked mirror: {gold}.

chat._note: What Sam and a lady talk about when he chats with her. home is used for ladies from Sam's old world.
topics: about the strangest client of the week
about Sam's old world. She refuses to believe in trains
about what she wants to do with her life
about whether "isekai" is a real word (she insists it is not)
home: about home, and what they miss most

outfit_market.title: A Find at the Market
text: {name} comes back from the market with a bundle under her arm. "I found {outfit}. It was practically calling my name, and I got it for almost nothing."
{name} holds up {outfit}, still folded from the stall. "Look what I found. The seller had no idea what it was worth."

keep.label: "It suits you."
res: She hugs the bundle to her chest. {outfit} is hers.

share.label: "Put it in the house wardrobe."
res: {name} shrugs happily. "Then everyone can borrow it." {outfit} joins the house wardrobe.

outfit_regular.title: A Present from a Regular
text: A parcel arrives at the front desk, addressed to {name}. Inside is {outfit} and a note: "For a lady with good taste. - an admirer."
One of {name}'s regulars has left a gift for her at the door: {outfit}, wrapped in tissue paper.

keep.label: "Keep it, it's yours."
res: {name} tries it on in front of the mirror, delighted. {outfit} is hers.

share.label: "Let the house share it."
res: {name} thinks about it, then nods. {outfit} goes into the house wardrobe, and the regular's note goes on the wall.

outfit_friend._vars: {name} = the lady, {other} = her friend, {outfit} = the outfit
outfit_friend.title: Borrowed Finery
text: {other} presses {outfit} into {name}'s hands. "It never fit me right. You take it."
"Try this on," says {other}, handing {name} {outfit}. "I've had it for ages. It was made for someone with your look."

share.label: "Hang it in the house wardrobe."
res: {other} laughs. "Fine, fine. Anyone can wear it, then." {outfit} joins the house wardrobe.

outfit_made.title: Handmade
text: {name} spent her evenings with a needle and a bolt of cloth. She holds up the result: {outfit}. "I made it myself. What do you think?"
{name} lays something across the kitchen table, stitched by candlelight: {outfit}. "It took a while, but I'm proud of it."

keep.label: "It's wonderful. Wear it."
res: {name} glows. {outfit} is hers, and she made it.

share.label: "Let the whole house enjoy it."
res: {name} blushes and nods. {outfit} goes into the house wardrobe.

gift._note: When Sam gives a lady a gift. The gift itself comes from people.json gifts.
normal: She smiles and tucks it away carefully.
